title: 原子力顯微鏡
summary: 以懸臂為奈牛頓等級的力感測器出發，理解 AFM 如何用光槓桿把皮米偏折放大成可量測的訊號，再把懸臂製作、共振模式、彈簧常數校正、熱雜訊、閉迴路掃描與標準樣品驗收整合成可交接的表面計量工程。
summaryEn: Start from the cantilever as a nanonewton force sensor to see how an AFM amplifies picometre deflections into measurable signals with an optical lever, then integrate cantilever fabrication, resonance modes, spring-constant calibration, thermal noise, closed-loop scanning and reference-sample acceptance into a transferable surface-metrology record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 校正與雜訊練習：在 300 K 以光槓桿量得某懸臂的熱振動 rms 為 0.130 nm，k = 0.817×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.130×10⁻⁹)² ≈ 0.20 N/m；力曲線的接觸段斜率給 InvOLS = 28 nm/V。設定偏折 0.05 V 相當於 1.4 nm，作用力 F = 0.20×1.4 = 0.28 nN。該懸臂 f₀ = 15 kHz、Q = 50，熱雜訊密度 √(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.20×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 130 fm/√Hz，加上偵測器 20 fm/√Hz 得 132 fm/√Hz；若影像頻寬 1 kHz，高度雜訊約 4.2 pm rms，對 0.34 nm 的石墨烯台階信噪比約 80；把頻寬降到 100 Hz，雜訊降為 1.3 pm，但每像素需 10 ms，512×512 影像需 44 分鐘，漂移 1.2 nm/min 會累積 53 nm，必須用漂移補償。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Calibration and noise exercise: at 300 K an optical lever records a thermal rms of 0.130 nm for a cantilever, so k = 0.817×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.130×10⁻⁹)² ≈ 0.20 N/m, and the contact slope of a force curve gives InvOLS = 28 nm/V. A deflection set point of 0.05 V equals 1.4 nm and a force F = 0.20×1.4 = 0.28 nN. With f₀ = 15 kHz and Q = 50 the thermal noise density is √(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.20×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 130 fm/√Hz, and with 20 fm/√Hz of detector noise the total is 132 fm/√Hz; at a 1 kHz imaging bandwidth the height noise is about 4.2 pm rms, a signal-to-noise ratio near 80 on a 0.34 nm graphene step; narrowing the bandwidth to 100 Hz lowers the noise to 1.3 pm but needs 10 ms per pixel, so a 512×512 frame takes 44 minutes and 1.2 nm/min of drift accumulates 53 nm, which demands drift compensation. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「探針作用力與懸臂力感測」與「動態模式：振幅調變與頻率調變」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 探針作用力與懸臂力感測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cantilever–tip–surface force” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原子力顯微鏡不需要導電樣品，它把一支末端帶尖銳探針的微懸臂靠近表面，由探針與表面之間的作用力使懸臂彎曲。遠距離時以凡得瓦吸引力與靜電力為主，接觸後以泡利排斥與彈性變形為主，液體中還有毛細力與雙電層力。懸臂依虎克定律 F = k·Δz 把力轉成偏折，彈簧常數從 0.01 N/m 的軟懸臂到 40 N/m 的硬懸臂，對應可量測的力從 pN 到 µN。成像時回授系統維持偏折（接觸模式）或振幅、頻率（動態模式）為定值，Z 軸的回授輸出即為地形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An atomic force microscope needs no conducting sample: a microcantilever carrying a sharp tip approaches the surface and the tip–surface force bends it. At long range van der Waals attraction and electrostatic forces dominate, in contact Pauli repulsion and elastic deformation take over, and in liquid capillary and double-layer forces appear as well. The cantilever converts force to deflection through Hooke's law F = k·Δz, with spring constants from 0.01 N/m for soft levers to 40 N/m for stiff ones, spanning measurable forces from piconewtons to micronewtons. During imaging the feedback holds the deflection (contact mode) or the amplitude or frequency (dynamic modes) constant, and the Z feedback output is the topography. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cantilever–tip–surface force”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：接觸模式用 k = 0.2 N/m 的懸臂、設定偏折 2 nm，作用力 F = 0.2 × 2×10⁻⁹ = 0.4 nN；探針半徑 R = 10 nm 壓在等效模數 E* = 1 GPa 的聚合物上，Hertz 接觸壓痕深度 δ = (9F²/(16 R E*²))^(1/3) = (9×1.6×10⁻¹⁹/(16×10⁻⁸×10¹⁸))^(1/3) ≈ (9×10⁻³⁰)^(1/3) ≈ 0.21 nm，接觸半徑 a = √(Rδ) ≈ 1.4 nm；若把偏折設到 20 nm，力變 4 nN，壓痕增為 0.97 nm，軟材料將被明顯壓扁。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In contact mode with a k = 0.2 N/m lever and a 2 nm deflection set point the force is F = 0.2 × 2×10⁻⁹ = 0.4 nN; a tip of radius R = 10 nm pressed into a polymer with reduced modulus E* = 1 GPa gives a Hertz indentation δ = (9F²/(16 R E*²))^(1/3) = (9×1.6×10⁻¹⁹/(16×10⁻⁸×10¹⁸))^(1/3) ≈ (9×10⁻³⁰)^(1/3) ≈ 0.21 nm and a contact radius a = √(Rδ) ≈ 1.4 nm; raising the set point to 20 nm makes 4 nN and a 0.97 nm indentation, visibly flattening soft materials.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「AFM 探針只是輕輕碰到表面，施加的力可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The AFM tip merely touches the surface, so the applied force is negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cantilever–tip–surface force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 探針作用力與懸臂力感測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cantilever–tip–surface force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接觸模式用 k = 0.2 N/m 的懸臂、設定偏折 2 nm，作用力 F = 0.2 × 2×10⁻⁹ = 0.4 nN；探針半徑 R = 10 nm 壓在等效模數 E* = 1 GPa 的聚合物上，Hertz 接觸壓痕深度 δ = (9F²/(16 R E*²))^(1/3) = (9×1.6×10⁻¹⁹/(16×10⁻⁸×10¹⁸))^(1/3) ≈ (9×10⁻³⁰)^(1/3) ≈ 0.21 nm，接觸半徑 a = √(Rδ) ≈ 1.4 nm；若把偏折設到 20 nm，力變 4 nN，壓痕增為 0.97 nm，軟材料將被明顯壓扁。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In contact mode with a k = 0.2 N/m lever and a 2 nm deflection set point the force is F = 0.2 × 2×10⁻⁹ = 0.4 nN; a tip of radius R = 10 nm pressed into a polymer with reduced modulus E* = 1 GPa gives a Hertz indentation δ = (9F²/(16 R E*²))^(1/3) = (9×1.6×10⁻¹⁹/(16×10⁻⁸×10¹⁸))^(1/3) ≈ (9×10⁻³⁰)^(1/3) ≈ 0.21 nm and a contact radius a = √(Rδ) ≈ 1.4 nm; raising the set point to 20 nm makes 4 nN and a 0.97 nm indentation, visibly flattening soft materials. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在硬的平坦表面（如藍寶石或矽）取力—距離曲線：接近段應平坦，接觸後偏折對壓電位移的斜率應為 1（nm/nm），這同時校正光槓桿靈敏度；再在聚合物上取曲線，用 Hertz 或 DMT 模型擬合壓痕段得到模數，與已知值比較；拉開時的黏附跳離力記錄為 pull-off 力，空氣中常為數 nN。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record a force–distance curve on a hard flat surface such as sapphire or silicon: the approach segment should be flat and the post-contact slope of deflection versus piezo travel should be 1 (nm/nm), which simultaneously calibrates the optical-lever sensitivity; then take curves on a polymer, fit the indentation segment with a Hertz or DMT model to obtain the modulus and compare with the known value; log the adhesion jump-off on retraction as the pull-off force, typically a few nanonewtons in air.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 探針作用力與懸臂力感測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cantilever–tip–surface force” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在硬的平坦表面（如藍寶石或矽）取力—距離曲線：接近段應平坦，接觸後偏折對壓電位移的斜率應為 1（nm/nm），這同時校正光槓桿靈敏度；再在聚合物上取曲線，用 Hertz 或 DMT 模型擬合壓痕段得到模數，與已知值比較；拉開時的黏附跳離力記錄為 pull-off 力，空氣中常為數 nN。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record a force–distance curve on a hard flat surface such as sapphire or silicon: the approach segment should be flat and the post-contact slope of deflection versus piezo travel should be 1 (nm/nm), which simultaneously calibrates the optical-lever sensitivity; then take curves on a polymer, fit the indentation segment with a Hertz or DMT model to obtain the modulus and compare with the known value; log the adhesion jump-off on retraction as the pull-off force, typically a few nanonewtons in air. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：設定力過大會讓探針在軟樣品上犁出溝槽或把生物分子推走，影像看起來平整卻是被壓平後的假象；在空氣中忽略毛細力，則實際作用力比設定值高出數 nN，探針磨損加快、解析度隨時間變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An excessive set-point force ploughs grooves into soft samples or sweeps biomolecules away, so the image looks smooth only because the surface has been flattened; ignoring capillary force in air means the real load exceeds the set point by several nanonewtons, accelerating tip wear so resolution degrades over time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在硬的平坦表面（如藍寶石或矽）取力—距離曲線：接近段應平坦，接觸後偏折對壓電位移的斜率應為 1（nm/nm），這同時校正光槓桿靈敏度；再在聚合物上取曲線，用 Hertz 或 DMT 模型擬合壓痕段得到模數，與已知值比較；拉開時的黏附跳離力記錄為 pull-off 力，空氣中常為數 nN。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「探針作用力與懸臂力感測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing"?
options: 在硬的平坦表面（如藍寶石或矽）取力—距離曲線：接近段應平坦，接觸後偏折對壓電位移的斜率應為 1（nm/nm），這同時校正光槓桿靈敏度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
閉迴路掃描器會自動修正所有漂移，因此不需要等熱平衡。
optionsEn: Record a force–distance curve on a hard flat surface such as sapphire or silicon: the approach segment should be flat and the post-contact slope of deflection versus piezo travel should be 1 (nm/nm), which simultaneously calibrates the optical-lever sensitivity.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A closed-loop scanner corrects all drift automatically, so waiting for thermal equilibrium is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 在硬的平坦表面（如藍寶石或矽）取力—距離曲線：接近段應平坦，接觸後偏折對壓電位移的斜率應為 1（nm/nm），這同時校正光槓桿靈敏度；再在聚合物上取曲線，用 Hertz 或 DMT 模型擬合壓痕段得到模數，與已知值比較；拉開時的黏附跳離力記錄為 pull-off 力，空氣中常為數 nN。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record a force–distance curve on a hard flat surface such as sapphire or silicon: the approach segment should be flat and the post-contact slope of deflection versus piezo travel should be 1 (nm/nm), which simultaneously calibrates the optical-lever sensitivity; then take curves on a polymer, fit the indentation segment with a Hertz or DMT model to obtain the modulus and compare with the known value; log the adhesion jump-off on retraction as the pull-off force, typically a few nanonewtons in air. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 探針作用力與懸臂力感測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cantilever–tip–surface force” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 設定力過大會讓探針在軟樣品上犁出溝槽或把生物分子推走，影像看起來平整卻是被壓平後的假象；在空氣中忽略毛細力，則實際作用力比設定值高出數 nN，探針磨損加快、解析度隨時間變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An excessive set-point force ploughs grooves into soft samples or sweeps biomolecules away, so the image looks smooth only because the surface has been flattened; ignoring capillary force in air means the real load exceeds the set point by several nanonewtons, accelerating tip wear so resolution degrades over time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：成像時回授系統維持偏折（接觸模式）或振幅、頻率（動態模式）為定值，Z 軸的回授輸出即為地形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During imaging the feedback holds the deflection (contact mode) or the amplitude or frequency (dynamic modes) constant, and the Z feedback output is the topography.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「AFM 探針只是輕輕碰到表面，施加的力可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The AFM tip merely touches the surface, so the applied force is negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「探針作用力與懸臂力感測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tip–surface forces and cantilever force sensing" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
設定力過大會讓探針在軟樣品上犁出溝槽或把生物分子推走，影像看起來平整卻是被壓平後的假象。
品質因數越高，影像一定越清楚，所以在空氣中也該追求高 Q。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
An excessive set-point force ploughs grooves into soft samples or sweeps biomolecules away, so the image looks smooth only because the surface has been flattened.
A higher quality factor always gives sharper images, so high Q should be pursued in air too.
quiz.explanation: 設定力過大會讓探針在軟樣品上犁出溝槽或把生物分子推走，影像看起來平整卻是被壓平後的假象；在空氣中忽略毛細力，則實際作用力比設定值高出數 nN，探針磨損加快、解析度隨時間變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An excessive set-point force ploughs grooves into soft samples or sweeps biomolecules away, so the image looks smooth only because the surface has been flattened; ignoring capillary force in air means the real load exceeds the set point by several nanonewtons, accelerating tip wear so resolution degrades over time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 動態模式：振幅調變與頻率調變：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dynamic modes: amplitude and frequency modulation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動態模式讓懸臂在共振頻率附近振動，探針只在每個週期最低點短暫接觸或完全不接觸表面，橫向力幾乎為零。小振幅時作用力梯度 ∂F/∂z 會改變有效彈簧常數，使共振頻率移動 Δf ≈ −(f₀/2k)·∂F/∂z；振幅調變（輕敲）模式維持振幅定值，頻率調變模式用鎖相迴路直接追蹤 Δf。空氣中品質因數 Q 約數百，液體中只有個位數，真空中可達 10⁴ 以上；Q 越高振幅反應越慢，時間常數 τ = Q/(π f₀)，這是真空中必須改用頻率調變的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic modes drive the cantilever near resonance so the tip touches the surface only briefly at the bottom of each cycle or not at all, almost eliminating lateral force. For small amplitudes the force gradient ∂F/∂z modifies the effective spring constant and shifts the resonance by Δf ≈ −(f₀/2k)·∂F/∂z; amplitude-modulation (tapping) mode holds the amplitude constant, while frequency-modulation mode tracks Δf directly with a phase-locked loop. The quality factor Q is a few hundred in air, single digits in liquid and above 10⁴ in vacuum; the higher the Q the slower the amplitude responds, with time constant τ = Q/(π f₀), which is why vacuum work switches to frequency modulation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輕敲懸臂 f₀ = 300 kHz、k = 40 N/m，若作用力梯度 1 N/m，Δf ≈ −(300×10³/80)×1 = −3.75 kHz；真空 FM-AFM 用 f₀ = 160 kHz、k = 40 N/m，梯度 0.01 N/m 給 Δf ≈ −20 Hz，仍可由鎖相迴路分辨。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a tapping lever with f₀ = 300 kHz and k = 40 N/m, a force gradient of 1 N/m gives Δf ≈ −(300×10³/80)×1 = −3.75 kHz; a vacuum FM-AFM lever with f₀ = 160 kHz and k = 40 N/m sees Δf ≈ −20 Hz for a 0.01 N/m gradient, still resolvable by the phase-locked loop.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「品質因數越高，影像一定越清楚，所以在空氣中也該追求高 Q。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A higher quality factor always gives sharper images, so high Q should be pursued in air too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「動態模式：振幅調變與頻率調變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dynamic modes: amplitude and frequency modulation" is correct?
options: 品質因數越高，影像一定越清楚，所以在空氣中也該追求高 Q。
同一盒懸臂的彈簧常數都等於標示值，不必逐支校正。
動態模式讓懸臂在共振頻率附近振動，探針只在每個週期最低點短暫接觸或完全不接觸表面，橫向力幾乎為零。
optionsEn: A higher quality factor always gives sharper images, so high Q should be pursued in air too.

quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic modes drive the cantilever near resonance so the tip touches the surface only briefly at the bottom of each cycle or not at all, almost eliminating lateral force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 動態模式：振幅調變與頻率調變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dynamic modes: amplitude and frequency modulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輕敲懸臂 f₀ = 300 kHz、k = 40 N/m，若作用力梯度 1 N/m，Δf ≈ −(300×10³/80)×1 = −3.75 kHz；真空 FM-AFM 用 f₀ = 160 kHz、k = 40 N/m，梯度 0.01 N/m 給 Δf ≈ −20 Hz，仍可由鎖相迴路分辨。振幅反應時間：空氣 Q = 400 時 τ = 400/(π×300×10³) ≈ 0.42 ms；真空 Q = 20 000 時 τ ≈ 21 ms，每像素停留若只有 1 ms，振幅迴授根本來不及反應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a tapping lever with f₀ = 300 kHz and k = 40 N/m, a force gradient of 1 N/m gives Δf ≈ −(300×10³/80)×1 = −3.75 kHz; a vacuum FM-AFM lever with f₀ = 160 kHz and k = 40 N/m sees Δf ≈ −20 Hz for a 0.01 N/m gradient, still resolvable by the phase-locked loop. Amplitude response time: in air with Q = 400, τ = 400/(π×300×10³) ≈ 0.42 ms; in vacuum with Q = 20 000, τ ≈ 21 ms, so with only 1 ms per pixel the amplitude feedback cannot keep up. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先掃頻取得自由振盪的共振曲線，由半高寬求 Q 與 f₀；接近表面時記錄振幅與相位對距離的曲線，確認振幅線性下降區間與相位的吸引／排斥轉折；在 FM 模式用已知的 Si(111)-7×7 或 KBr 表面驗證頻率位移影像，並用 Albrecht 公式估計頻率雜訊與實測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sweep the drive to obtain the free resonance curve and extract Q and f₀ from the half-power width; while approaching, record amplitude and phase versus distance, confirming the linear amplitude-reduction region and the attractive-to-repulsive phase transition; in FM mode validate frequency-shift images on a known Si(111)-7×7 or KBr surface and compare the measured frequency noise with the Albrecht estimate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 動態模式：振幅調變與頻率調變：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dynamic modes: amplitude and frequency modulation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先掃頻取得自由振盪的共振曲線，由半高寬求 Q 與 f₀；接近表面時記錄振幅與相位對距離的曲線，確認振幅線性下降區間與相位的吸引／排斥轉折；在 FM 模式用已知的 Si(111)-7×7 或 KBr 表面驗證頻率位移影像，並用 Albrecht 公式估計頻率雜訊與實測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sweep the drive to obtain the free resonance curve and extract Q and f₀ from the half-power width; while approaching, record amplitude and phase versus distance, confirming the linear amplitude-reduction region and the attractive-to-repulsive phase transition; in FM mode validate frequency-shift images on a known Si(111)-7×7 or KBr surface and compare the measured frequency noise with the Albrecht estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輕敲模式若設定振幅比太低，探針從吸引區跳進排斥區，相位突然翻轉，影像出現高度跳變與對比反轉；使用者常誤以為樣品有台階，實際上是回授在雙穩態之間切換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With too low an amplitude set-point ratio in tapping mode the tip jumps from the attractive into the repulsive regime, the phase flips abruptly and images show height jumps and contrast inversion; users often read these as sample steps when the feedback is really switching between two stable states.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 動態模式：振幅調變與頻率調變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dynamic modes: amplitude and frequency modulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 輕敲模式若設定振幅比太低，探針從吸引區跳進排斥區，相位突然翻轉，影像出現高度跳變與對比反轉；使用者常誤以為樣品有台階，實際上是回授在雙穩態之間切換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With too low an amplitude set-point ratio in tapping mode the tip jumps from the attractive into the repulsive regime, the phase flips abruptly and images show height jumps and contrast inversion; users often read these as sample steps when the feedback is really switching between two stable states. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「品質因數越高，影像一定越清楚，所以在空氣中也該追求高 Q。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A higher quality factor always gives sharper images, so high Q should be pursued in air too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸臂製作、彈簧常數與探針半徑」與「光槓桿偵測與閉迴路掃描器」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 懸臂製作、彈簧常數與探針半徑：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cantilever fabrication, spring constant and tip radius: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「矽懸臂與探針尖端」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Silicon cantilever and tip apex” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 懸臂以單晶矽或氮化矽經微影與各向異性蝕刻批次製作，探針由矽柱經氧化銳化而成，尖端半徑約 5 到 20 nm。矩形懸臂的彈簧常數 k = E·w·t³/(4L³) 與厚度的三次方成正比，而晶圓厚度控制只有 ±10% 等級，所以同一批懸臂的 k 可相差 30% 以上，必須逐支校正。探針並非理想的點，影像是表面與探針形狀的膨脹（dilation）結果：任何比探針半徑更陡的特徵都會被探針輪廓取代。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽懸臂與探針尖端」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cantilevers are batch-fabricated from single-crystal silicon or silicon nitride by lithography and anisotropic etching, and tips are sharpened from silicon pillars by oxidation to an apex radius of about 5 to 20 nm. A rectangular lever has k = E·w·t³/(4L³), proportional to the cube of thickness, while wafer thickness control is only at the ±10% level, so levers from one batch can differ in k by more than 30% and each must be calibrated. The tip is not an ideal point: the image is the dilation of the surface by the tip shape, and any feature steeper than the tip profile is replaced by the tip's own outline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Silicon cantilever and tip apex”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With silicon E = 169 GPa, ρ = 2330 kg/m³, L = 225 µm, w = 30 µm and t = 3 µm: k = 169×10⁹×30×10⁻⁶×(3×10⁻⁶)³/(4×(225×10⁻⁶)³) ≈ 3.0 N/m, and the resonance f₀ ≈ 0.162·(t/L²)·√(E/ρ) = 0.162×(3×10⁻⁶/5.06×10⁻⁸)×8517 ≈ 82 kHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一盒懸臂的彈簧常數都等於標示值，不必逐支校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every lever in a box has the labelled spring constant, so per-lever calibration is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「矽懸臂與探針尖端」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Silicon cantilever and tip apex”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 懸臂製作、彈簧常數與探針半徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cantilever fabrication, spring constant and tip radius: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「矽懸臂與探針尖端」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Silicon cantilever and tip apex” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取矽的 E = 169 GPa、ρ = 2330 kg/m³、L = 225 µm、w = 30 µm、t = 3 µm：k = 169×10⁹×30×10⁻⁶×(3×10⁻⁶)³/(4×(225×10⁻⁶)³) ≈ 3.0 N/m；共振頻率 f₀ ≈ 0.162·(t/L²)·√(E/ρ) = 0.162×(3×10⁻⁶/5.06×10⁻⁸)×8517 ≈ 82 kHz。厚度若為 3.3 µm（+10%），k 升為 4.0 N/m（+33%）。探針膨脹：半徑 R = 10 nm 的探針掃過高 h = 2 nm 的台階，每側展寬約 √(2Rh) = √40 ≈ 6.3 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With silicon E = 169 GPa, ρ = 2330 kg/m³, L = 225 µm, w = 30 µm and t = 3 µm: k = 169×10⁹×30×10⁻⁶×(3×10⁻⁶)³/(4×(225×10⁻⁶)³) ≈ 3.0 N/m, and the resonance f₀ ≈ 0.162·(t/L²)·√(E/ρ) = 0.162×(3×10⁻⁶/5.06×10⁻⁸)×8517 ≈ 82 kHz. A thickness of 3.3 µm (+10%) raises k to 4.0 N/m (+33%). Tip dilation: a tip of radius R = 10 nm crossing a step of height h = 2 nm broadens each edge by about √(2Rh) = √40 ≈ 6.3 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用 SEM 量懸臂的 L、w 與 t 並代入公式，與熱雜訊法或 Sader 法的 k 比較，三者差異應在 20% 以內；探針半徑用尖刺陣列樣品（如 TGT1）做盲重建（blind reconstruction），或掃描已知寬度的奈米線，從展寬反推 R，並在長時間掃描後重測以追蹤磨損。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the lever's L, w and t by SEM and insert them into the formula, then compare with the thermal-noise or Sader value of k, expecting agreement within 20%; estimate the tip radius by blind reconstruction on a spike-array sample such as TGT1 or by scanning nanowires of known width and inverting the broadening, and re-measure after long scans to track wear.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With silicon E = 169 GPa, ρ = 2330 kg/m³, L = 225 µm, w = 30 µm and t = 3 µm: k = 169×10⁹×30×10⁻⁶×(3×10⁻⁶)³/(4×(225×10⁻⁶)³) ≈ 3.0 N/m, and the resonance f₀ ≈ 0.162·(t/L²)·√(E/ρ) = 0.162×(3×10⁻⁶/5.06×10⁻⁸)×8517 ≈ 82 kHz. A thickness of 3.3 µm (+10%) raises k to 4.0 N/m (+33%). Tip dilation: a tip of radius R = 10 nm crossing a step of height h = 2 nm broadens each edge by about √(2Rh) = √40 ≈ 6.3 nm.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 懸臂製作、彈簧常數與探針半徑：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「矽懸臂與探針尖端」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Silicon cantilever and tip apex” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用 SEM 量懸臂的 L、w 與 t 並代入公式，與熱雜訊法或 Sader 法的 k 比較，三者差異應在 20% 以內；探針半徑用尖刺陣列樣品（如 TGT1）做盲重建（blind reconstruction），或掃描已知寬度的奈米線，從展寬反推 R，並在長時間掃描後重測以追蹤磨損。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the lever's L, w and t by SEM and insert them into the formula, then compare with the thermal-noise or Sader value of k, expecting agreement within 20%; estimate the tip radius by blind reconstruction on a spike-array sample such as TGT1 or by scanning nanowires of known width and inverting the broadening, and re-measure after long scans to track wear. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：探針磨鈍或沾上碎屑後，所有凸起特徵呈現同樣的形狀（探針的像），寬度被高估數十 nm，顆粒尺寸統計整體偏大；若把這些尺寸當成製程回饋，會誤調微影或沉積參數。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A blunt or debris-laden tip makes every protrusion take the same shape, the tip's own image, overestimating widths by tens of nanometres and biasing particle-size statistics upward; feeding such dimensions back into a process wrongly adjusts lithography or deposition parameters.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.observation: 量級提示：末端受力懸臂的端點斜率 θ = 3Δz/(2L)，反射光偏轉 2θ，在距離 D 的二極體上位移 ΔX = 2θ·D = 3D·Δz/L。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：末端受力懸臂的端點斜率 θ = 3Δz/(2L)，反射光偏轉 2θ，在距離 D 的二極體上位移 ΔX = 2θ·D = 3D·Δz/L。取 L = 225 µm、D = 40 mm：ΔX/Δz = 3×40/0.225 ≈ 533，1 nm 偏折給 0.53 µm 的光點位移；若雷射光點直徑 30 µm，差訊號相對變化約 0.53/30 ≈ 1.8% 每 nm，以 2 V 的總和訊號換算得約 36 mV/nm，反向靈敏度 InvOLS ≈ 28 nm/V。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.observation: 如何核對：在硬表面取力曲線，以接觸段斜率直接量 InvOLS（nm/V），每次換懸臂或移動雷射光點後重做；掃描器則用已知節距（如 3 µm 或 10 µm）的光柵在不同掃描範圍與速度下量正反向誤差，閉迴路開啟後殘差應小於 0.1%；再把電容感測器的雜訊（典型 0.1 nm rms）記錄為橫向解析度的下限。

steps.title: 彈簧常數與高度尺度的校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibrating spring constant and height scale: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱雜訊頻譜與台階高度標準片」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal spectrum and step-height standard” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 力的量測需要兩個校正：光槓桿靈敏度（V 到 nm）與彈簧常數（nm 到 nN）。彈簧常數最常用熱雜訊法：由能量均分定理，懸臂的熱振動均方位移 ⟨z²⟩ 與 k_B·T/k 成正比，量頻譜中第一共振峰的面積即可求 k；光槓桿偵測的是斜率而非位移，加上第一模態只佔總能量的 97%，因此需要 Butt–Jaschke 修正係數 0.817。高度尺度則靠可溯源的台階高度標準片與節距光柵校正，Z 感測器與壓電的非線性要分段記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱雜訊頻譜與台階高度標準片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Force measurement needs two calibrations: the optical-lever sensitivity (volts to nanometres) and the spring constant (nanometres to nanonewtons). The thermal-noise method is the usual route to k: by equipartition the mean-square thermal displacement ⟨z²⟩ of the lever scales as k_B·T/k, so integrating the first resonance peak of the measured spectrum yields k; because the optical lever senses slope rather than displacement and the first mode carries only 97% of the energy, the Butt–Jaschke correction factor 0.817 is applied. The height scale is calibrated with traceable step-height standards and pitch gratings, and the nonlinearity of the Z sensor and piezo is recorded range by range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal spectrum and step-height standard”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：k = 0.817·k_B·T/⟨z*²⟩。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: k = 0.817·k_B·T/⟨z*²⟩.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱雜訊法只要量 rms 就好，光槓桿的斜率效應可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.titleEn: Calibrating spring constant and height scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱雜訊頻譜與台階高度標準片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal spectrum and step-height standard” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：k = 0.817·k_B·T/⟨z*²⟩。在 T = 300 K，k_B·T = 4.14×10⁻²¹ J；若光槓桿量得的熱振動 rms 為 0.130 nm，⟨z*²⟩ = 1.69×10⁻²⁰ m²，k = 0.817×4.14×10⁻²¹/1.69×10⁻²⁰ ≈ 0.20 N/m。對 40 N/m 的硬懸臂，rms 只有 √(0.817×4.14×10⁻²¹/40) ≈ 9.2 pm，接近偵測器底噪，熱法不確定度升到 20% 以上。高度校正：100.0 nm 標準台階量得 98.6 nm，Z 修正係數 1.014。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: k = 0.817·k_B·T/⟨z*²⟩. Height calibration: a 100.0 nm standard step measuring 98.6 nm gives a Z correction factor of 1.014. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：熱雜訊法取至少 100 次平均的頻譜，用簡諧振子加白噪底的模型擬合，記錄 f₀、Q 與 k，並與 Sader 法（由尺寸、Q、f₀ 與流體密度計算）比較，兩者差異超過 15% 時檢查雷射光點位置；高度校正用至少兩種台階（如 20 nm 與 100 nm）在影像中央與邊緣各量一次，比較壓電非線性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For the thermal method average at least 100 spectra, fit a harmonic-oscillator plus white-noise model, log f₀, Q and k, and compare with the Sader method (from dimensions, Q, f₀ and fluid density); investigate the laser-spot position whenever the two differ by more than 15%; for height calibration measure at least two steps (for example 20 nm and 100 nm) at the image centre and edge to compare piezo nonlinearity.

steps.instruction: 熱雜訊法取至少 100 次平均的頻譜，用簡諧振子加白噪底的模型擬合，記錄 f₀、Q 與 k，並與 Sader 法（由尺寸、Q、f₀ 與流體密度計算）比較，兩者差異超過 15% 時檢查雷射光點位置；高度校正用至少兩種台階（如 20 nm 與 100 nm）在影像中央與邊緣各量一次，比較壓電非線性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 熱雜訊與偵測器雜訊預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Thermal and detector noise budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏折訊號雜訊底」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deflection-signal noise floor” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AFM 的垂直解析度由三類雜訊決定：懸臂本身的熱布朗運動、光槓桿與光電二極體的散粒與電子雜訊，以及掃描器與環境的機械雜訊。在遠低於共振的頻率，熱雜訊密度為 √(4k_B·T/(k·ω₀·Q))，所以軟而低頻、低 Q 的接觸懸臂最吵；硬而高頻的懸臂熱雜訊可低於 1 fm/√Hz，此時偵測器雜訊（典型 10 到 50 fm/√Hz）反而是主因。輕敲與 FM 模式工作在共振上，熱雜訊被 Q 放大，但訊號也被放大，真正的限制變成頻率或振幅雜訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏折訊號雜訊底」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vertical resolution is set by three noise classes: the lever's own thermal Brownian motion, shot and electronic noise of the optical lever and photodiode, and mechanical noise from the scanner and environment. Well below resonance the thermal noise density is √(4k_B·T/(k·ω₀·Q)), so soft, low-frequency, low-Q contact levers are the noisiest; stiff high-frequency levers fall below 1 fm/√Hz and the detector noise, typically 10 to 50 fm/√Hz, dominates instead. Tapping and FM modes operate on resonance where thermal noise is amplified by Q, but so is the signal, and the true limit becomes frequency or amplitude noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deflection-signal noise floor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A contact lever with k = 0.2 N/m, f₀ = 15 kHz (ω₀ = 9.4×10⁴ s⁻¹), Q = 50 and T = 300 K: √(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.2×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 1.3×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz = 130 fm/√Hz, or about 4.2 pm rms in a 1 kHz bandwidth; a stiff lever with k = 40 N/m, f₀ = 300 kHz and Q = 400 gives 0.74 fm/√Hz, only 23 fm in 1 kHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雜訊都來自電子線路，懸臂本身不會產生雜訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All noise comes from electronics; the cantilever itself produces none." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偏折訊號雜訊底」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Deflection-signal noise floor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 熱雜訊與偵測器雜訊預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal and detector noise budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏折訊號雜訊底」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deflection-signal noise floor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接觸懸臂 k = 0.2 N/m、f₀ = 15 kHz（ω₀ = 9.4×10⁴ s⁻¹）、Q = 50、T = 300 K：√(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.2×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 1.3×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz = 130 fm/√Hz，1 kHz 頻寬內 rms ≈ 4.2 pm；硬懸臂 k = 40 N/m、f₀ = 300 kHz、Q = 400 給 0.74 fm/√Hz，1 kHz 內僅 23 fm。加上 20 fm/√Hz 的偵測器雜訊：接觸懸臂總計 √(130² + 20²) ≈ 132 fm/√Hz，幾乎全是熱雜訊；硬懸臂總計 20 fm/√Hz，幾乎全是偵測器。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A contact lever with k = 0.2 N/m, f₀ = 15 kHz (ω₀ = 9.4×10⁴ s⁻¹), Q = 50 and T = 300 K: √(4×4.14×10⁻²¹/(0.2×9.4×10⁴×50)) ≈ 1.3×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz = 130 fm/√Hz, or about 4.2 pm rms in a 1 kHz bandwidth; a stiff lever with k = 40 N/m, f₀ = 300 kHz and Q = 400 gives 0.74 fm/√Hz, only 23 fm in 1 kHz. Adding 20 fm/√Hz of detector noise: the contact lever totals √(130² + 20²) ≈ 132 fm/√Hz, almost entirely thermal, while the stiff lever totals 20 fm/√Hz, almost entirely detector. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把雷射對準懸臂但探針遠離表面，記錄偏折訊號的功率譜密度：共振以下的平台應與熱雜訊加偵測器雜訊的估計相符，共振峰形狀給出 Q；再用遮住雷射或打到固定反射鏡的方式單獨量偵測器底噪，兩者相減即為懸臂熱雜訊，並在 1 kHz 頻寬內換算 rms 與影像上的高度雜訊比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align the laser on the lever with the tip far from the surface and record the deflection power spectral density: the plateau below resonance should match the thermal-plus-detector estimate and the peak shape gives Q; then measure the detector floor alone by blocking the laser or reflecting it from a fixed mirror, subtract to isolate the lever's thermal noise, and convert to rms in a 1 kHz bandwidth for comparison with the height noise seen in images.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 熱雜訊與偵測器雜訊預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal and detector noise budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏折訊號雜訊底」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Deflection-signal noise floor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把雷射對準懸臂但探針遠離表面，記錄偏折訊號的功率譜密度：共振以下的平台應與熱雜訊加偵測器雜訊的估計相符，共振峰形狀給出 Q；再用遮住雷射或打到固定反射鏡的方式單獨量偵測器底噪，兩者相減即為懸臂熱雜訊，並在 1 kHz 頻寬內換算 rms 與影像上的高度雜訊比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align the laser on the lever with the tip far from the surface and record the deflection power spectral density: the plateau below resonance should match the thermal-plus-detector estimate and the peak shape gives Q; then measure the detector floor alone by blocking the laser or reflecting it from a fixed mirror, subtract to isolate the lever's thermal noise, and convert to rms in a 1 kHz bandwidth for comparison with the height noise seen in images. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用軟接觸懸臂追求次奈米的高度精度而不縮減頻寬，4 pm 等級的熱雜訊疊在 0.3 nm 的單原子層台階上，台階邊緣無法判定；換成硬懸臂又因偵測器雜訊與較大的作用力壓壞軟樣品，兩種選擇都失敗，因為沒有先做預算。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Chasing sub-nanometre height precision with a soft contact lever and no bandwidth reduction stacks 4 pm thermal noise onto a 0.3 nm monolayer step so the edge cannot be located; switching to a stiff lever then fails through detector noise and the larger force crushing a soft sample, and both choices fail because no budget was made first.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 用軟接觸懸臂追求次奈米的高度精度而不縮減頻寬，4 pm 等級的熱雜訊疊在 0.3 nm 的單原子層台階上，台階邊緣無法判定；換成硬懸臂又因偵測器雜訊與較大的作用力壓壞軟樣品，兩種選擇都失敗，因為沒有先做預算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雜訊都來自電子線路，懸臂本身不會產生雜訊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環境、漂移與回授整合」與「標準樣品驗收與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Environment, drift and feedback integration" and "Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環境、漂移與回授整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Environment, drift and feedback integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整機性能由機械迴路決定：從探針經懸臂座、掃描器、機架到樣品座的所有零件構成一個結構迴路，溫度變化會讓迴路各段不等膨脹而造成漂移，聲音與地板振動會激發迴路共振。因此 AFM 放在隔音罩與隔振平台上，整機熱平衡後才取像。回授增益需與掃描速度、樣品起伏匹配：增益太低地形被低通濾掉且探針撞上陡坡，太高則回授自激，影像出現高頻條紋；誤差訊號影像是判斷回授是否跟得上的直接證據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Whole-instrument performance is set by the mechanical loop: every part from tip through lever holder, scanner and frame to sample holder forms a structural loop, temperature changes expand its segments unequally and cause drift, and sound or floor vibration excites its resonances. The AFM therefore sits under an acoustic hood on an isolation platform and images only after thermal equilibrium. Feedback gains must match scan speed and surface relief: too little gain low-pass filters the topography and the tip collides with steep slopes, too much gain makes the loop oscillate with high-frequency stripes, and the error-signal image is the direct evidence of whether feedback keeps up. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：結構迴路長 50 mm、鋼材 CTE 12 ppm/K，實驗室溫度每分鐘漂 0.02 K：漂移 ≈ 50×10⁻³×12×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 12 nm/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 mm structural loop in steel with CTE 12 ppm/K in a laboratory drifting 0.02 K per minute moves about 50×10⁻³×12×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 12 nm/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉迴路掃描器會自動修正所有漂移，因此不需要等熱平衡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A closed-loop scanner corrects all drift automatically, so waiting for thermal equilibrium is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 環境、漂移與回授整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Environment, drift and feedback integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：結構迴路長 50 mm、鋼材 CTE 12 ppm/K，實驗室溫度每分鐘漂 0.02 K：漂移 ≈ 50×10⁻³×12×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 12 nm/min。512 條線、每線 1 s 的影像需 512 s，累積約 100 nm，對 1 µm 視野是 10% 的扭曲；熱穩定 1 小時後溫度斜率降到 0.002 K/min，漂移約 1.2 nm/min，影像扭曲降到 1%。回授方面，1 Hz 線頻、512 像素時每像素 1 ms，迴路頻寬至少需 1 kHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 mm structural loop in steel with CTE 12 ppm/K in a laboratory drifting 0.02 K per minute moves about 50×10⁻³×12×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 12 nm/min. A 512-line frame at 1 s per line takes 512 s and accumulates about 100 nm, a 10% distortion over a 1 µm field; after an hour of thermal settling the slope falls to 0.002 K/min, drift to about 1.2 nm/min and the distortion to 1%. For feedback, a 1 Hz line rate with 512 pixels gives 1 ms per pixel, so the loop bandwidth must be at least 1 kHz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開機後每 10 分鐘對同一特徵取像，用互相關求位移向量對時間的曲線，等斜率低於允許值再開始量測；同時比較高度影像與誤差訊號影像，誤差訊號的 rms 應遠小於地形起伏，並在陡坡處無明顯拖尾；最後用麥克風與加速規確認隔音罩內的聲壓與振動頻譜無共振放大。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After start-up image the same feature every 10 minutes, cross-correlate to get the displacement-versus-time curve, and start measuring only once the slope is below the allowance; at the same time compare the height image with the error-signal image, whose rms should be far below the relief with no tailing at steep edges; finally use a microphone and accelerometer to confirm that sound pressure and vibration inside the hood show no resonant amplification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 結構迴路長 50 mm、鋼材 CTE 12 ppm/K，實驗室溫度每分鐘漂 0.02 K：漂移 ≈ 50×10⁻³×12×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 12 nm/min。512 條線、每線 1 s 的影像需 512 s，累積約 100 nm，對 1 µm 視野是 10% 的扭曲；熱穩定 1 小時後溫度斜率降到 0.002 K/min，漂移約 1.2 nm/min，影像扭曲降到 1%。回授方面，1 Hz 線頻、512 像素時每像素 1 ms，迴路頻寬至少需 1 kHz。
knowledge.textEn: A 50 mm structural loop in steel with CTE 12 ppm/K in a laboratory drifting 0.02 K per minute moves about 50×10⁻³×12×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 12 nm/min. A 512-line frame at 1 s per line takes 512 s and accumulates about 100 nm, a 10% distortion over a 1 µm field; after an hour of thermal settling the slope falls to 0.002 K/min, drift to about 1.2 nm/min and the distortion to 1%. For feedback, a 1 Hz line rate with 512 pixels gives 1 ms per pixel, so the loop bandwidth must be at least 1 kHz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 環境、漂移與回授整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Environment, drift and feedback integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 開機後每 10 分鐘對同一特徵取像，用互相關求位移向量對時間的曲線，等斜率低於允許值再開始量測；同時比較高度影像與誤差訊號影像，誤差訊號的 rms 應遠小於地形起伏，並在陡坡處無明顯拖尾；最後用麥克風與加速規確認隔音罩內的聲壓與振動頻譜無共振放大。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After start-up image the same feature every 10 minutes, cross-correlate to get the displacement-versus-time curve, and start measuring only once the slope is below the allowance; at the same time compare the height image with the error-signal image, whose rms should be far below the relief with no tailing at steep edges; finally use a microphone and accelerometer to confirm that sound pressure and vibration inside the hood show no resonant amplification. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了趕時間在開機 10 分鐘內取像，漂移把圓形顆粒拉成橢圓並讓正反向影像錯位；又為了修正而把增益調高，結果迴路在 2 到 5 kHz 自激，影像出現細密條紋，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋，量測結果完全不可信。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Imaging within 10 minutes of start-up to save time lets drift stretch circular particles into ellipses and misregister forward and backward frames; raising the gain to compensate makes the loop oscillate at 2 to 5 kHz with fine stripes, and the two errors mask each other so the results cannot be trusted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 環境、漂移與回授整合：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了趕時間在開機 10 分鐘內取像，漂移把圓形顆粒拉成橢圓並讓正反向影像錯位；又為了修正而把增益調高，結果迴路在 2 到 5 kHz 自激，影像出現細密條紋，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋，量測結果完全不可信。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：回授增益需與掃描速度、樣品起伏匹配：增益太低地形被低通濾掉且探針撞上陡坡，太高則回授自激，影像出現高頻條紋；誤差訊號影像是判斷回授是否跟得上的直接證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Feedback gains must match scan speed and surface relief: too little gain low-pass filters the topography and the tip collides with steep slopes, too much gain makes the loop oscillate with high-frequency stripes, and the error-signal image is the direct evidence of whether feedback keeps up.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉迴路掃描器會自動修正所有漂移，因此不需要等熱平衡。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A closed-loop scanner corrects all drift automatically, so waiting for thermal equilibrium is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 標準樣品驗收與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」如何決定原子力顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance standards and handoff record” determines the key performance of “Atomic force microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AFM 的驗收把前面的模型變成可重複的測試：可溯源的台階高度與節距光柵驗證 Z 與 XY 尺度，懸臂熱頻譜驗證彈簧常數與雜訊底，尖刺樣品驗證探針半徑，長時間重複成像驗證漂移，硬表面的力曲線驗證靈敏度與線性度。交接紀錄要包含每個掃描範圍的校正係數、感測器雜訊、所用懸臂型號與量得的 k、f₀、Q，以及環境條件，因為任何一項改變都會讓後續量測的不確定度失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: AFM acceptance turns the earlier models into repeatable tests: traceable step heights and pitch gratings verify the Z and XY scales, the lever's thermal spectrum verifies spring constant and noise floor, a spike sample verifies tip radius, long repeated imaging verifies drift, and force curves on a hard surface verify sensitivity and linearity. The handoff record must contain calibration factors for each scan range, sensor noise, the lever type with its measured k, f₀ and Q, and the environmental conditions, because a change in any of them invalidates the uncertainty of later measurements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance standards and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：驗收門檻範例：100.0 ± 0.6 nm 標準台階量得 98.6 nm，偏差 −1.4%，校正後重量應落在 ±1% 內；3.000 µm 光柵量得 2.985 µm，XY 修正 1.005；接觸硬表面時 Z 雜訊 25 pm rms（1 kHz 頻寬），對 20 nm 台階信噪比 800，對 0.34 nm 石墨烯單層台階約 14，仍可判讀；探針半徑由尖刺樣品重建得 12 nm，與標稱 10 nm 相符；30 分鐘漂移 1.5 nm/min，低於 2 nm/min 的允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Example acceptance thresholds: a 100.0 ± 0.6 nm standard step measuring 98.6 nm is a −1.4% deviation and must re-measure within ±1% after correction; a 3.000 µm grating measuring 2.985 µm gives an XY correction of 1.005; Z noise in contact with a hard surface is 25 pm rms (1 kHz bandwidth), a signal-to-noise ratio of 800 on a 20 nm step and about 14 on a 0.34 nm graphene monolayer step, still readable; the tip radius reconstructed from the spike sample is 12 nm against a nominal 10 nm; drift after 30 minutes is 1.5 nm/min, below the 2 nm/min allowance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「AFM 的高度值是絕對的，不需要用標準片校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "AFM height values are absolute and need no calibration against standards." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance standards and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：驗收門檻範例：100.0 ± 0.6 nm 標準台階量得 98.6 nm，偏差 −1.4%，校正後重量應落在 ±1% 內；3.000 µm 光柵量得 2.985 µm，XY 修正 1.005；接觸硬表面時 Z 雜訊 25 pm rms（1 kHz 頻寬），對 20 nm 台階信噪比 800，對 0.34 nm 石墨烯單層台階約 14，仍可判讀；探針半徑由尖刺樣品重建得 12 nm，與標稱 10 nm 相符；30 分鐘漂移 1.5 nm/min，低於 2 nm/min 的允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Example acceptance thresholds: a 100.0 ± 0.6 nm standard step measuring 98.6 nm is a −1.4% deviation and must re-measure within ±1% after correction; a 3.000 µm grating measuring 2.985 µm gives an XY correction of 1.005; Z noise in contact with a hard surface is 25 pm rms (1 kHz bandwidth), a signal-to-noise ratio of 800 on a 20 nm step and about 14 on a 0.34 nm graphene monolayer step, still readable; the tip radius reconstructed from the spike sample is 12 nm against a nominal 10 nm; drift after 30 minutes is 1.5 nm/min, below the 2 nm/min allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依固定順序執行：熱頻譜與 k；硬表面力曲線與 InvOLS；台階與光柵在三個掃描範圍各量三次並取平均與標準差；尖刺樣品探針重建；同一區域 30 分鐘重複成像求漂移；全部結果填入與模型並列的驗收表，任何項目超出允收值需重做校正並記錄原因。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Execute in a fixed order: thermal spectrum and k; hard-surface force curve and InvOLS; step and grating measured three times at three scan ranges with mean and standard deviation; tip reconstruction on the spike sample; repeated imaging of one area for 30 minutes for drift; enter every result into an acceptance table beside its model value, and redo the calibration with a recorded cause whenever an item exceeds its allowance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「標準樣品驗收與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff", which statement holds?

Every lever in a box has the labelled spring constant, so per-lever calibration is unnecessary.
The thermal method only needs the rms value; the slope effect of the optical lever can be ignored.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 標準樣品驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance standards and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依固定順序執行：熱頻譜與 k；硬表面力曲線與 InvOLS；台階與光柵在三個掃描範圍各量三次並取平均與標準差；尖刺樣品探針重建；同一區域 30 分鐘重複成像求漂移；全部結果填入與模型並列的驗收表，任何項目超出允收值需重做校正並記錄原因。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Execute in a fixed order: thermal spectrum and k; hard-surface force curve and InvOLS; step and grating measured three times at three scan ranges with mean and standard deviation; tip reconstruction on the spike sample; repeated imaging of one area for 30 minutes for drift; enter every result into an acceptance table beside its model value, and redo the calibration with a recorded cause whenever an item exceeds its allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只驗收一個掃描範圍的尺度，使用者在小範圍量奈米顆粒時壓電非線性讓尺寸偏差 5% 以上；交接紀錄漏掉懸臂的實測 k，後續力學量測全部引用標稱值，模數結果系統性偏差卻無人察覺。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Accepting the scale at one scan range only lets piezo nonlinearity bias nanoparticle sizes by more than 5% when users work at small ranges; omitting the measured k from the handoff record makes every later mechanical measurement fall back on the nominal value, so modulus results carry a systematic bias nobody notices.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依固定順序執行：熱頻譜與 k；硬表面力曲線與 InvOLS；台階與光柵在三個掃描範圍各量三次並取平均與標準差；尖刺樣品探針重建；同一區域 30 分鐘重複成像求漂移；全部結果填入與模型並列的驗收表，任何項目超出允收值需重做校正並記錄原因。
knowledge.textEn: Execute in a fixed order: thermal spectrum and k; hard-surface force curve and InvOLS; step and grating measured three times at three scan ranges with mean and standard deviation; tip reconstruction on the spike sample; repeated imaging of one area for 30 minutes for drift; enter every result into an acceptance table beside its model value, and redo the calibration with a recorded cause whenever an item exceeds its allowance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「標準樣品驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 標準樣品驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance standards and handoff record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只驗收一個掃描範圍的尺度，使用者在小範圍量奈米顆粒時壓電非線性讓尺寸偏差 5% 以上；交接紀錄漏掉懸臂的實測 k，後續力學量測全部引用標稱值，模數結果系統性偏差卻無人察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting the scale at one scan range only lets piezo nonlinearity bias nanoparticle sizes by more than 5% when users work at small ranges; omitting the measured k from the handoff record makes every later mechanical measurement fall back on the nominal value, so modulus results carry a systematic bias nobody notices. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含每個掃描範圍的校正係數、感測器雜訊、所用懸臂型號與量得的 k、f₀、Q，以及環境條件，因為任何一項改變都會讓後續量測的不確定度失效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must contain calibration factors for each scan range, sensor noise, the lever type with its measured k, f₀ and Q, and the environmental conditions, because a change in any of them invalidates the uncertainty of later measurements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「AFM 的高度值是絕對的，不需要用標準片校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "AFM height values are absolute and need no calibration against standards." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只驗收一個掃描範圍的尺度，使用者在小範圍量奈米顆粒時壓電非線性讓尺寸偏差 5% 以上；交接紀錄漏掉懸臂的實測 k，後續力學量測全部引用標稱值，模數結果系統性偏差卻無人察覺。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「標準樣品驗收與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

AFM 探針只是輕輕碰到表面，施加的力可以忽略。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The AFM tip merely touches the surface, so the applied force is negligible.
Accepting the scale at one scan range only lets piezo nonlinearity bias nanoparticle sizes by more than 5% when users work at small ranges.
